remarks: ***The seller has received multiple offers and is requesting highest and best offers by 12PM Monday 6/29***Welcome to 69 Willowbrook Avenue, a charming beachside home in one of Stamford's most convenient coastal locations. Offered for the first time in 70 years, this well-maintained and lovingly cared-for home features 2 bedrooms, 2 full baths, central air, fresh paint, a finished basement, and a flat, usable yard. The boiler and hot water tank are approximately 2 years old, adding peace of mind. Warm, inviting, and full of character, this special home offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and coastal living. Ideally located just minutes from Cove Island, Cummings Park, Chelsea Piers, beaches, parks, restaurants, downtown Stamford, I-95, and the train station. Less than one hour from NYC.
